subject.title: Reduce remote node bin probe churn

question: Should remote macOS bin probes adopt this 24-hour success cache and exponential failure backoff after the branch is ported to `src/skills/runtime/remote.*`, or should maintainers require a narrower readiness/backoff policy?
rationale: The choice affects remote skill freshness, retry suppression, startup/reconnect warning behavior, and approved macOS node execution compatibility; source inspection shows the branch is stale but the policy itself still needs owner intent.

options.title: Port and prove active runtime
options.body: Keep this work open only as a refreshed branch or replacement that ports the cache/backoff logic to `src/skills/runtime/remote.*`, preserves preflight and snapshot behavior, and adds real macOS node proof.

options.title: Narrow the timing policy
options.body: Require shorter TTL/backoff windows or additional invalidation if maintainers do not want remote skill eligibility to remain stale for up to 24 hours.

options.title: Close for fresh replacement
options.body: If the old branch is not worth salvaging, close it after a maintainer decision and ask for a new narrow PR against the active runtime while keeping the canonical issue open.

recommendation.title: Port and prove active runtime
recommendation.body: Keep this work open only as a refreshed branch or replacement that ports the cache/backoff logic to `src/skills/runtime/remote.*`, preserves preflight and snapshot behavior, and adds real macOS node proof.

likelyOwner.reason: `steipete` has the strongest feature-history signal for mac node exec, remote skill probing, and the policy tradeoff.
